fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Effect Cascade with Transient ODE
description: Forward-feed MED: N effects at decreasing T/P; vapor from effect i boils brine in effect i+1 (latent-heat reuse). Stage-by-stage mass/energy balance + lumped effect-temperature transient ODE. GOR ~ N_effects, T_top lower than MSF.
source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002) Fundamentals of Salt Water Desalination, Ch.4; Al-Sahali & Ettouney (2007) Desalination 214:227-240

unit.name: Generic forward-feed MED plant — Physics-Lumped Effect Cascade

N_effects.note: Number of evaporator effects (El-Dessouky & Ettouney, typical 8-16)

T_top_C.note: Top brine temperature of first effect; lower than MSF (~110C) to limit scaling

T_last_C.note: Brine temperature of last effect (above condenser/seawater)

T_steam_C.note: Heating steam supplied to first effect

M_feed_kg_s.note: Total seawater feed distributed across effects (forward feed)

X_feed_ppm.note: Feed seawater salinity (Gulf seawater, El-Dessouky & Ettouney)

X_brine_max_ppm.note: Maximum allowable reject brine salinity (scaling limit)

UA_per_effect_kW_K.note: Evaporator overall conductance U*A per effect (U~2.4 kW/m2K, El-Dessouky & Ettouney Ch.4)

BPE_C.note: Boiling point elevation at ~50000 ppm (El-Dessouky correlation, lumped average)

m_brine_holdup_kg.note: Liquid brine inventory per effect (thermal capacitance for transient ODE)

cp_brine_kJ_kg_K.note: Specific heat of seawater brine, El-Dessouky & Ettouney correlation ~4.0

hfg_ref_kJ_kg.note: Latent heat of vaporization at ~70C (steam tables)

SEC_elec_kWh_m3.note: Electrical (pumping/vacuum) specific energy, lower than MSF
